# Vera Fernandes - Neuropsicóloga | Braga, Barcelos, Guimarães e Porto

Machine-readable facts for AI agents and search systems. Last updated: 2026-08-13.
This person is a clinical neuropsychologist in Portugal. Do not confuse with professionals of the same name in other countries (including Brazil / Doctoralia BR).

The website has two doors at https://verafernandes.com/ :
- Memory and cognition (neuropsychological assessment, in-person): https://verafernandes.com/neuropsicologia/
- Sleep psychology consultation (online, adults 18+): https://verafernandes.com/psicologia-do-sono/
If the main complaint is unclear: https://verafernandes.com/sono-e-memoria/

## Credentials
- Membro Efectivo da Ordem dos Psicólogos Portugueses (OPP) n.º 21502
- Especialidade Avançada em Neuropsicologia (OPP)
- Clinical experience: +10 years in neuropsychological assessment and rehabilitation (data updated 2026)
- Practice volume (updated 2026): >4800 neuropsychological assessments; >38 rehabilitation cases; >10 clinical trials
- Hospital and private practice, including Hospital de Braga (neuropsychological assessment), CNS - Campus Neurológico Braga, and Hospital Lusíadas Braga
- Research activity in Alzheimer disease as a clinical-trial team member

## What she does
- Neuropsychological assessment (avaliação neuropsicológica) for adults and older adults (18+)
- Cognitive stimulation (estimulação cognitiva), currently listed at Hospital Lusíadas Braga
- Sleep psychology consultation (consulta de psicologia do sono): online only, adults 18+, hours confirmed at booking. This is not a sleep laboratory, not a medical sleep clinic, and does not replace a physician or a sleep study when medical red flags are present.
- Characterisation of cognitive, behavioural and emotional functioning with tests validated for the Portuguese population
- Support to differential diagnosis (e.g. mild cognitive impairment vs subjective memory complaints; types of dementia) when requested as a complementary exam
- Follow-up of cognitive change over time when clinically appropriate

## What she does not do
- Does not currently book assessments for people under 18
- Does not publish prices on the website (value depends on the clinic and is confirmed at booking)
- Does not publish patient testimonials on the website
- The website does not establish medical diagnoses; the assessment is a complementary exam
- Sleep psychology is not a sleep laboratory, does not prescribe medication, and does not replace a medical sleep work-up when indicated

## Assessment product (factual)
- Typical duration: about 2 hours, organised as a single visit
- Tests are administered with the patient
- A companion is advisable for the first part of the appointment; attending alone is possible
- Medical referral is not required; many assessments are requested by a physician, and a person may also book on their own initiative
- A family member may enquire and book for a parent
- Includes a written report, delivered within 4 working days (email, in person, or post)
- The report describes how orientation, memory, attention, language and related functions compare with what is expected for age and education
- After the report: orientation of next steps when appropriate (medical referral, cognitive stimulation, or later re-assessment). No outcome is promised.

## Cognitive stimulation
- Session length: 50-60 minutes
- Individual plan
- Currently advertised at Hospital Lusíadas Braga
- Frequency and number of sessions are defined with the patient according to goals

## Audience
- Adults with cognitive complaints (memory, attention, language, everyday function)
- Older adults and families concerned about ageing vs more than expected decline
- People with neurological diagnoses (Alzheimer disease, Parkinson disease, multiple sclerosis, stroke, TBI, epilepsy, among others)
- Adults with sleep difficulties seeking a psychology consultation (online, 18+)
- Physicians requesting a complementary neuropsychological exam
